summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow individuals to use funds from health savings accounts, flexible spending arrangements, health reimbursement arrangements, and Archer MSAs for the medical expenses of their parents or their spouse's parents.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to expand the definition of medical expenses that can be covered by Health Savings Accounts, Flexible Spending Arrangements, Health Reimbursement Arrangements, and Archer MSAs to include expenses for parents. This effectively lowers the taxable income for individuals who use these accounts for parental care, thus leading to lower taxes for those individuals. The bill is primarily focused on these tax code changes.
